## Conditional owner approval — GitGuardian incident 38407534 (23 October 2026)

The owner **conditionally approves** changing **only incident 38407534** to **Ignored → Test credential**, and acknowledges that future alerts for the same incident will be suppressed.

**Mandatory precondition (NOT YET VERIFIED):** An authorised operator must authenticate to GitGuardian and perform a read-only review of the *complete incident occurrence inventory*, verifying that every occurrence is synthetic-only and none involves real credentials, live services or unreviewed exposure. Confirm edit permissions. **Stop without changing incident status** if the scope differs or cannot be established.

Only after preflight PASS: record this approval and the security assessment, apply exactly that incident classification (no other incidents), and rerun the existing GitGuardian check. Capture actual new check ID/SHA/status and independent security reassessment. Do not infer PASS from the incident change.

No disabling scans, broad ignore rules, history rewrite, skipped checks, branch protection changes, merge, production deployment, GitHub billing changes or accounting activation authorised.

**Current state:** approval CONDITIONALLY RECORDED; authenticated preflight PENDING; disposition NOT APPLIED; GitGuardian NO-GO; PR #102 Draft; T19 In progress; accounting activation NO-GO.
